layer: V1: 链上生存与第一笔交易

title.zh: 托管边界、冷钱包与多签安全

summary.zh: 补齐进入 Web3 的资产托管全景：拆解中心化交易所（CEX）的账面欠条与挤兑风险，以及硬件冷签名与 Safe M-of-N 多签钱包如何守住大额资产。
summary.en: Understand CEX IOUs vs self-custody, Proof of Reserves limits, hardware cold signing, and M-of-N Safe multisig security.

title.zh: CEX 托管、储备证明（PoR）与自托管对比沙盒
title.en: CEX Custody, Proof of Reserves & Self-Custody

subtitle.zh: 交易所里的余额只是一张电子欠条！亲手模拟交易所挪用资金遭遇挤兑，理解“Not your keys, not your coins”。
subtitle.en: Simulate exchange bank runs and why Proof of Assets without Proof of Liabilities cannot stop insolvency.

title.zh: 硬件冷签名与多签钱包（Safe M-of-N）攻防模拟器
title.en: Hardware Cold Signing & Safe Multisig Lab

subtitle.zh: 电脑中木马、助记词丢了一把，为什么 2-of-3 多签 + 硬件钱包依然能保住全部资产？
subtitle.en: Test single-point-of-failure attacks against hot wallets, hardware wallets, and M-of-N Safe multisigs.
